block.name: Fix bridge.drain() no-op in Praxis and Elmer pulse loops
acceptance_criteria: Praxis/core/praxis_hook.py calls bridge.sync_state() — no bridge.drain() call remains
Elmer/elmer_service.py calls bridge.sync_state() — no bridge.drain() or bridge.read_tract() call remains
Both files pass python3 -m py_compile with no errors
Both repos committed and pushed to GitHub

never: Modify vendored files (ng_tract_bridge.py, ng_lite.py, ng_ecosystem.py, ng_peer_bridge.py, ng_autonomic.py, ng_embed.py, openclaw_adapter.py)
Add _extract_text_from_delta or any text-extraction step — that is a Law 7 violation deferred to punchlist #154
anti_drift: Do not refactor beyond the two targeted drain call fixes
The fix is a call to sync_state() only — no event iteration replaces the old loop

steps.description: Remove stale partial clone directories from any previous runs
Skip Praxis patch if already applied

params.new_text:
#         resets turn tracking.
# [2026-04-15] Claude Code (Sonnet 4.6) — Punchlist #137: Fix bridge.drain() no-op
#   What: Replace bridge.drain() with bridge.sync_state() in _pulse_cycle().
#   Why:  NGTractBridge has no public drain() method. hasattr guard silently
#         skipped the entire tract drain — pulse loop was a no-op for River.
#   How:  sync_state(local_state={}, module_id=MODULE_ID) calls _drain_all()
#         internally, clearing incoming tracts and updating bridge state.
#         Event routing removed — Law 7 violation deferred to punchlist #154.
# -------------------

if_false.description: Replace bridge.drain() block with bridge.sync_state() in Praxis pulse cycle

params.new_text:
if bridge and hasattr(bridge, 'sync_state'):
                bridge.sync_state(local_state={}, module_id=self.MODULE_ID)

steps.description: Verify bridge.drain() is gone from praxis_hook.py
Skip Elmer patch if already applied

params.new_text:

#         loop removed — Law 7 violation deferred to punchlist #154.

params.new_text:
if bridge and hasattr(bridge, 'sync_state'):
                    bridge.sync_state(local_state={}, module_id="elmer")
